note: BBVA Argentina's card interest rates (in force October 2026): its Visa Internacional's financing rate is a nominal 66.67% a year in pesos. The central bank's transparency register (information of 9 October 2026) gives the card's maximum monthly administration and maintenance fee as 30,000 pesos, at list price, and no renewal fee. Banco de la Nación Argentina's Visa Internacional, from the same register: a maximum effective annual rate of 101.33% on financing, a maximum monthly administration fee of 10,446.99 pesos and a yearly renewal fee of 185,740.00, both at list price; the bank's own schedule of charges gives them, with VAT, as 10,447.00 a month and 185,740.00 a year.
